anvil.condition: Ground EN8 carbon steel billet resting under its own weight on a lubricated, preheated H13 die before upsetting
anvil.lubricant: Undiluted DeltaForge F-31 brushed on the die
anvil.notes: Conductance inferred from die temperature measurements. The die was preheated to 250 C and its surface warmed during contact. The reference flux uses its nominal initial temperature at a common 850 C billet surface for comparison. The coupon furnace setpoint is not the contact surface temperature.

water.notes: Inversely fitted convection coefficient. The paper's Abaqus boundary includes a separate radiation term. Use only with the documented bar geometry and agitated conditions for calibration. The inferred coefficient reflects the stirred experiment and does not characterize a stationary tank or resolve early film boiling.

agitation.method: Bar moved in a circle through the water

oil.condition: SUS304 disk edge insulated by a jig, Daphne Bright Quench oil
oil.notes: Inferred effective transfer coefficients differ between the upper and lower faces. Keep the two curves distinct. The text identifies Figure 8(a) as temperature-dependent while its printed x-axis label says time. Confirm the axis and digitization before using it as an input curve.
